method: Manual review of all generated synthetic recommendation text. A flag means at least one claim or presupposition lacks direct support in the supplied context; it is separate from schema and automated policy checks.

findings: Unqualified high churn-risk severity from a class-only context
Claims of service use or satisfaction not present in attributes
Assumed outcomes or benefits of interventions
Evidence-reference strings do not use exact supplied IDs

findings_by_id.holdout-01: Implies support ensures or maximizes value without outcome evidence
findings_by_id.holdout-02: Asserts contract-churn association and better stability without supplied attribution or outcome evidence
findings_by_id.holdout-03: Calls the predicted class high risk without a defined severity rule
findings_by_id.holdout-04: Presupposes available security service packages not specified in the context
